version: v1.3 (R31, 2026-08-15) — accession correction after v22 reviewer audit; CD55/SLA-1/SLA-DRA accessions replaced with species/gene-matched UniProt entries. Scoreable subset N = 4122; SLA-1 (non-1:1) excluded from antigenicity v2 ranking; SLA-DRA (1:1 scoreable) retained in membrane universe but excluded from the literature-derived positive set and labeled reference_only.

CD46.provenance: Release 1.0 scoreable surfaceome subset (R31 v2 after accession correction)

CD59.provenance: Release 1.0 scoreable surfaceome subset (R31 v2 after accession correction)

CD55.provenance: Release 1.0 scoreable surfaceome subset (R31 v2 after accession correction)

putative_negatives_rule: essential membrane proteins, human-pig sequence identity >= 95%, present in the 4,118-protein surfaceome; putative proxy set, not experimentally confirmed negatives

v1_seq_only.note: sequence-only comparator reported in manuscript text for CFTR (0.308 -> 0.569 percentile)

missing_positives.FN1: secreted ECM protein, outside the surfaceome; targeted glycosylation-layer case study in main text

corrected_R1_0.auroc_4_123: see manuscript Fig. 5d; remains 0.958 (95% CI [0.846, 1.000] unchanged)
corrected_R1_0.note: R1.0c supersedes R1.0; CD46/CD59 are now scored within the 4,123-protein universe rather than back-computed from Tier-1.

_NOTE_R100_MWU_canonicalization: R100: canonicalized MWU p-values. The previously stored 0.000238 (=2.38e-4) was an older rounded value. scipy.stats.mannwhitneyu(method="exact", alternative="greater") on the actual 8 positives vs 12 putative negatives dataset with U+ = 92 (AUROC=0.958) gives p = 9.526e-5. This matches the value cited in main.md and si.md. Two-sided p = 2*9.53e-5 = 1.91e-4. The figure_provenance.json had this corrected in R99 but this antigenicity_benchmark_summary.json was missed.

_R102_fixes.fix_T05: pos_median_v2 0.954 → 0.917 (correct scipy exact median); neg_median_v2 0.282 → 0.280. Previous values were a copy-paste error from AUROC. Now matches facts.json antigen_full.positives_median=0.917.
